# GridLens

> GridLens is a free, browser-only Formula 1 season and race explorer. It renders
> championship standings, tyre strategy, lap pace, interval gaps and pit stops
> from OpenF1 data, covering every season the OpenF1 API holds (2023 onward).

Static single-page app. No account, no backend, no tracking. The browser calls
the OpenF1 REST API directly and caches cheap responses in localStorage.

## Data source

All motorsport data comes from [OpenF1](https://openf1.org/) (https://api.openf1.org).
GridLens does not operate the data source and is not affiliated with Formula 1,
the FIA, or OpenF1. OpenF1 only serves data from 2023 onward.

## Site structure

- `/` — redirects to the current season
- `/season/{year}` — season calendar, championship standings, points progression, strategy and pit charts (years 2023–2026)
- `/race/{year}/{meeting-slug}/pace` — lap pace chart and sector detail
- `/race/{year}/{meeting-slug}/gaps` — interval gaps between drivers
- `/race/{year}/{meeting-slug}/strategy` — tyre stint/compound strategies
- `/race/{year}/{meeting-slug}/pit` — pit stops, overtakes, starting grid

Race URLs are deep-linkable; each tab loads only the OpenF1 resources it needs.

## Notes for agents

- Year floor is 2023: requests for earlier seasons return 404 from OpenF1.
- Future (unrun) races have no data and are not linked.
- Human-readable entry points: `/sitemap.xml`, `/robots.txt`.
